chapter_seo_title: Dao Twisted World Chapter 228: The Beauty Paper – Social Horror at its Worst
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang learns the true horror of the Liang Kingdom. It's not monsters or rituals—it's what people do to each other when they have all the power. A deeply unsettling chapter.
og_title: Chapter 228 – The Beauty Paper: A Stain That Won't Wash Away
og_description: Sun Baolu's confession reveals a decadence so profound that human beings are used as toilet paper. Li Huowang's last hope for a paradise is broken.
twitter_title: Dao Twisted World Ch 228: They don't treat people like people in Liang.
twitter_description: Forget flesh Buddhas—this chapter's horror is a "Beauty Paper." A young woman used as living toilet paper by nobles. The social horror hits hardest.

lore_anchors.definition: A historical Chinese practice where a beautiful young maidservant was employed as a living piece of toilet paper for nobles, washed and reused between uses. Symbolizes extreme dehumanization in feudal hierarchies.
A related historical practice where a beautiful maidservant acted as a human spittoon, standing by her master to catch his spittle. A symbol of utter commodification of the human body.
Bai Lingmiao's home village in the Liang Kingdom. Given her description, it appears to be a sheltered, isolated community insulated from the worst of the kingdom's practices.

cultural_notes_faq.a: A historical term for a young woman used as a living rag by nobles to wipe themselves after using the toilet. She is cleaned and reused. It symbolizes the most extreme form of class-based dehumanization.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Bai Lingmiao think the Liang Kingdom is so nice?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She only knows her isolated home village of Niu Xin Shan, which was a close-knit, protected community. She has no personal experience with the decadent noble culture of the cities.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is this chapter setting up a future plot in the Liang Kingdom?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes. Li Huowang's plans to settle there are now shaken. The revelation of the kingdom's true nature is a major piece of worldbuilding that will likely influence his future decisions.
